page.title: Services
page.metaDescription: Custom NetSuite applications, tailored alternatives to licensed tools and connected AI assistants. Practical development around your team’s daily work.

netsuite.title: Custom applications.
paragraphs: We build custom applications that simplify daily work through clearer screens, automated tasks and connected tools. Employees spend less time switching between pages, repeating manual steps and entering the same information in different systems.

replacements.title: Choose the right tool.
paragraphs: We compare configuration, existing products and development around the features your team needs. Licences, setup and support are part of the decision. Sometimes the right answer is to improve what you already use.

ai.title: AI agents and assistants.
paragraphs: We connect AI agents to NetSuite, business documents and your other tools. Employees can ask questions, analyse information and get help with tasks, spending less time searching across systems.
We embed assistants in custom applications to guide users through their work and help them take action directly in the application, with fewer manual steps.

quick-so.title: Orders, in one clear screen.
quick-so.summary: A simpler way for sales teams to choose products and create an order directly in NetSuite.
quick-so.problem: Sales teams had to use NetSuite’s standard sales-order form. The process felt slow and hard to follow, making a routine part of their job frustrating.
quick-so.solution: We built a dedicated order-entry screen with the customer, products, quantities and order details together. Employees prepare and review the order in one clear interface. Once submitted, the sales order is created automatically in NetSuite.
quick-so.forYou: What would make work easier for your team? We build custom applications to simplify everyday tasks, automate repetitive work and connect your tools.

prp-v2.title: A sales application that fits.
prp-v2.summary: We built sales features directly in NetSuite to replace a separate sales application.
prp-v2.problem: The team needed essential sales functions in an interface simpler than its separate sales tool.
prp-v2.solution: We built the required sales features directly in NetSuite, bringing customers, products, prices, stock and orders together. Saved carts and order templates let employees resume work and prepare repeat orders without starting again.
prp-v2.forYou: Need a simpler interface or a replacement tool? Let’s compare useful features, licences and maintenance to choose an approach that fits.

supply-chain-workbench.title: A clearer view of your stock.
supply-chain-workbench.summary: A planning table to spot potential shortages and check incoming supply.
supply-chain-workbench.problem: The team needed to compare stock, forecasts and incoming deliveries to spot shortages and plan purchases. A stock figure on its own did not give enough context.
supply-chain-workbench.solution: We built a planning table that brings this information together by product, location and period. Employees can see where stock may run short and open the related purchase orders to investigate, without losing the overall view.
supply-chain-workbench.forYou: Which figures does your team need to compare before making a decision? We can bring them into one working view, highlight what needs attention and make the supporting details easy to reach.

quoting-assistants.title: AI, inside your tools.
quoting-assistants.summary: Agents that answer questions and help with tasks across NetSuite, documents and other tools. Assistants embedded in custom applications to guide users as they work.
quoting-assistants.problem: Finding information in NetSuite can be slow. Analysing information spread across documents and tools quickly takes up time that employees could spend on their work.
quoting-assistants.solution:
Across your tools, we implement agents connected to NetSuite, documents and other business systems. They help employees find answers, analyse information and carry out everyday tasks.

Inside your custom applications, we embed assistants that guide users, explain what to do and help them complete actions more easily and quickly.
quoting-assistants.forYou: What would you like an agent to help your team with? We can connect it to your tools and documents, or integrate an assistant into a custom application to guide the people using it.
